name: High Intensity Interval Sprints
instructions: Alternate 30 seconds of maximum effort sprinting with 45 seconds of active walking recovery.

name: Barbell Squats & Romanian Deadlifts
instructions: Maintain neutral spine, hinge hips backward, descend until thighs are parallel to ground.

name: Power Vinyasa Yoga Flow
instructions: Synchronize breath with dynamic flow between Downward Dog, Warrior II, and Plank.

name: Full Body Kettlebell HIIT
instructions: Complete kettlebell swings, clean & presses, and goblet squats with minimal rest.

name: Brisk Outdoor Power Walk
instructions: Maintain an upright posture, engage abdominal muscles, and swing arms rhythmically.

name: Core Pilates & Plank Progression
instructions: Perform forearm planks, side planks, bird-dogs, and hollow body holds.
